description:
Katie Tupper, the rising Canadian soul singer and former member of Saskatoon collective vbnd, follows her breakout EP 'Towards the End’, with her sophomore EP 'Where To Find Me'. The diverse collection of tracks highlights Katie's self-exploration of not only her musical identity, but also of her personal. "I feel so lucky and excited to be sharing this collection of songs," Katie reflects. "Each song I write and work on brings me one step closer to what I want my music to sound like. This EP is the closest I’ve felt yet. I really feel like my influences shine through in these songs and they feel really personal. I use music to try to figure myself out and to think about my identity." 

The final track to be revealed on the EP, "All of Me" is a mid-tempo ballad about the weight of certain confessions as Katie delves deeper into her true sexual identity. "Where I grew up in Saskatchewan it was always easy and normal for me to navigate feelings for men. Confessing feelings or desires felt safe and easy. It wasn’t until I was a bit older and living in a different part of the world that I realized my feelings for women. And these confessions of feelings and love felt so much more heavy. Admitting to feelings for someone felt more like admitting to a part of my identity along with the feelings. Small words and glances held a lot more weight than they did in the past."
